{{Enemy description|The "Thrylissoron Anavon" (archive ID: ACL072α) is an energized variant of ACL072. Its high energy contents did not affect its decision-making abilities. This entity is extremely dangerous.}}

==Overview==
A unique variant of [[Heavy Ram]], Heavy Rams α have similar appearance with their counterpart, but it doesn't make them less of the threat with most abilities remained:

*Rams at front, dealing Physical damage.
*Leaps after a short wind up, and followed by a ground pound, dealing Physical damage to Operators around.
*Charges ahead, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back.
*A stronger ram after a charge up, dealing Physical damage. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
